audit_plan.question: No burst/proof pressure report was found in the packet (reliability_report.md has no such section). Ask to see a proof test record: pressure held vs 3x the 6 bar maximum operating pressure (18 bar), hold of at least 60 s, and no rupture.

No PFMEA appears in the packet. Ask to see the current PFMEA for SI-CP-0007 and check it covers the three CTQs (base thickness, port bore, mounting-hole pitch) that the control plan lists (quality_manual.md §9.2).

No quoted lead time is in the packet. Ask for the quote and compare it with Stark's 12-week need-by. Check it against the demonstrated output of 2741 parts/week (capacity.md §1.1) and the ramp milestone of 2026-11-01 (capacity.md §9.1).
